paragraphs: Save Fuel Europe SAS is the exclusive distributor of Fuel Ox® in France. Developed over 30 years ago for AT&T and the US military, Fuel Ox® is a high-performance fuel treatment that optimizes combustion and significantly reduces fuel consumption.

Before Save Fuel Europe was even established, Fuel Ox® was tested on a 2005 Land Cruiser equipped with a D4D turbodiesel engine. Results showed fuel savings of 22%. These exceptional results convinced us of the product's potential and encouraged us to introduce it to the French market. See the Land Cruiser test report here.
Independent road tests conducted in France have confirmed these results. The minimum fuel reduction observed was 9%. The test report is available here.

how-fo-cuts-costs.p1: Fuel Ox® reduces fuel consumption through two complementary mechanisms. First, it cleans the engine and fuel system, helping to restore lost efficiency. Second, it promotes more complete combustion of the fuel, allowing the engine to extract more energy from every litre consumed.
how-fo-cuts-costs.p2: Testing on a 2005 turbocharged diesel vehicle showed an overall fuel saving of 22%, comprising:
how-fo-cuts-costs.p3: 17% from improved engine and fuel system cleanliness.

how-fo-cuts-costs.p6: You benefit from a possible reduction of 9% or more in your consumption. Try before you buy with a free trial using one of your vehicles.
how-fo-cuts-costs.p7: With our calculator here, you can easily visualize the potential savings. Enter the price of fuel and your monthly or yearly consumption and get a clear estimate of the possible monthly or annual gains across your entire fleet.

steps: The road test showed a reduction of 17% in fuel consumption due to decarbonisation of the fuel systems.
This improved combustion enabled an additional saving of 5%.

how-to-use-fuel-ox.p1: It takes some time running your vehicle for Fuel Ox® to clean the fuel system and break up fuel molecule clumps. A first treatment at twice the normal concentration of Fuel Ox® in a full fuel tank (2 mL per 10 litres of fuel) will give a faster result overall. When refuelling after the first tank, add 1 mL of Fuel Ox® for every 10 litres of fuel added to the tank.
how-to-use-fuel-ox.p2: You can expect fuel consumption to gradually improve until around five tanks of fuel have been used.
how-to-use-fuel-ox.p3: The 2-minute video here shows how to add Fuel Ox® to your vehicle or to storage containers.

intro.title: Test the reduction in your fuel consumption — free of charge.
intro.p1: At Save Fuel Europe, we offer you a free trial so you can see the possible savings for yourself before making any purchase.
intro.p2: We provide the quantity of Fuel Ox® needed to carry out this test under real operating conditions. For reliable results, we recommend using a vehicle that refuels at least twice a week and normally operates under similar conditions. Please download the application form, then email the completed form to us so that we have the information needed to set up your trial.

steps.title: How does the trial work?
steps.subtitle: The trial takes place in three simple steps:
steps: Start by filling up, always to the same level to ensure accuracy. Note your mileage, then use the vehicle normally. At the next fill-up, note the mileage and fuel quantity added again. This gives you your baseline consumption.
Then add Fuel Ox® at the start-up dose and continue using your vehicle normally. This phase gradually cleans the fuel system and optimizes its performance.
After this phase, continue with the normal dose of Fuel Ox®. Record your consumption data again to compare easily with your initial results.

direct-cost-benefit.title: Direct cost benefit
description: A large truck driving 150,000 km per year with average consumption of 30 L/100 km uses 45,000 litres of fuel per year. With a 9% reduction in consumption, this represents 4,050 litres saved.

Treating those 45,000 litres requires only 4.5 litres of Fuel Ox®, costing €891 ex VAT. At a fuel price of €1.50/litre, Fuel Ox® provides a net saving of €5,184 per year, including the cost of treatment.
For a fleet of 10 trucks, this represents a net annual saving on fuel of approximately €51,840.  Other cost benefits include reduced DPF regenerations and reduced AdBlue consumption.

manufacturers-guarantee.title: Manufacturer's guarantee
manufacturers-guarantee.p1_1: Fuel Ox® carries insurance for up to US$2,000,000 in case of damage to an engine caused by Fuel Ox® treatment. No claim has ever been made. No user has ever alleged that using Fuel Ox® damaged their engine.

EN590-ASTM-950.title: EN590 and ASTM-D975 compliance
EN590-ASTM-950.p1_1: Laboratory tests completed by Intertek in France compared untreated diesel with diesel treated with twice the normal concentration of Fuel Ox®. Most measurements were the same; seven showed tiny differences. The treated fuel remains compliant with the EN590 specification. The lab report also notes that treated red diesel also remains within specification. Fuel Ox® presence cannot be detected by testing to EN590. Engine warranty remains valid because the fuel meets the required specification.
EN590-ASTM-950.p1_2: See the France Intertek lab EN590 tests.
EN590-ASTM-950.p2: Comparative lab tests to the US standard ASTM-D975 also showed that treated fuel results were almost identical and met the standard.

save-fuel-europe-guarantee.title: Our Confidence in Fuel Ox
save-fuel-europe-guarantee.p1: Our own and many independent tests prove that Fuel Ox® treatment cuts vehicle fuel consumption from 6% up to 28%. Test reports are on the Vehicles page. The lowest saving from independent tests in France showed a 9% reduction in fuel consumption.
save-fuel-europe-guarantee.p2_1: Our guarantee is that if you perform a fuel efficiency trial using our
save-fuel-europe-guarantee.p2_3: and report the results to us, it will cost you nothing if there is no improvement in fuel efficiency.

historical-guarantee.title: Historical assurance
historical-guarantee.p1: Fuel Ox® was developed in the 1990s for AT&T and the US military. With a 30-year history, Fuel Ox® currently treats around 50,000,000 litres of fuel each month. Users would not continue to buy Fuel Ox® if it did not work.
historical-guarantee.p2: Proven technology over 30 years attests to the cost effectiveness of fuel treatment with Fuel Ox®.

direct-cost-benefit.title: Direct cost benefit
description: A typical well-maintained 100 kVA generator at 75% full load would burn around 21 L/hour, providing approximately 3.6 kWh/L. If used over 22 × 8-hour working days in a month, untreated fuel use would be 21 × 8 × 22 = 3,696 L. At a 9% reduction in consumption, this saves 332 L.

Treating 3,696 L of fuel takes 0.37 L of Fuel Ox®, costing €73 ex VAT. If fuel costs €1.67 ex VAT (€2.00 incl. VAT), a 9% saving cuts the fuel cost of one generator over one month by €482 ex VAT, including the cost of Fuel Ox®.
For remote locations, logistics become easier as each load of fuel lasts longer.

history.title: The science behind Fuel Ox®
history.p1: Bell Labs is an American scientific and industrial research laboratory founded in 1925. It developed radio astronomy, transistors, lasers, photovoltaic cells, charge-coupled devices, information theory, the Unix operating system, and several major programming languages. Its researchers have received eleven Nobel Prizes and five Turing Awards.
history.p2: The molecules of hydrocarbon fuels are polar — they have different electrical charges at different points on the molecule. This leads to polymerisation, where negative charges on one molecule adhere to positive charges on another. This causes clusters of molecules to form, preventing oxygen from reaching the molecules inside the cluster during combustion. Incomplete combustion produces soot and unburned hydrocarbons in the exhaust and requires more fuel to produce a given power output.
history.p3: Polymerisation increases over time, so after several months from production at the refinery, fuel can become unusable. It clogs filters and fuel lines and creates deposits inside injection systems. Engines become less efficient with use, meaning even more fuel must be burned to achieve a desired performance.
history.p4: Bell Labs belonged to the Atlantic Telephone and Telegraph Company (AT&T), which owned a vast fleet of vehicles across the United States. The laboratories developed a fuel treatment to break down and prevent fuel polymerisation, restoring engine performance and fuel combustion to improve shelf life and reduce fuel consumption. This fuel treatment was subsequently adopted by the US military. Its current name is Fuel Ox®, and it currently treats approximately 50 million litres of fuel per month, primarily in the United States.
history.p5: Fuel Ox® contains catalysts. A catalyst causes chemical reactions without being consumed by the reaction, so a small amount of catalyst will continue to act for a long time. Normal treatment with Fuel Ox® uses one part per 10,000. One litre of Fuel Ox® treats 10,000 litres of fuel. The improvement in combustion efficiency is approximately 5%. The improvement in engine efficiency can be much greater, depending on the condition of the engine.

about.title: Save Fuel Europe is the exclusive Fuel Ox® distributor in France
about.p1: We support transport, delivery, logistics companies and off-grid power users in reducing their fuel bills with a simple, efficient and engine-safe solution.
about.p2: Do you manage a fleet of commercial vehicles, trucks or generators and see fuel costs eroding your margins month after month? You know that a significant reduction would make all the difference, but you are hesitant to trust a distributor that is still relatively unknown in France?
about.p3: We fully understand this caution. Vehicle and generator fleet managers are primarily concerned with two things: avoiding any risk to expensive engines and managing operating costs.
about.p4: Save Fuel Europe is a small team of professionals. Without a large head office or flashy marketing, we focus on the essentials: a close, transparent and results-oriented service.
about.p5: We chose to start modestly to build real credibility with our clients. Our ambition is to provide long-term support to road transport companies, ski resorts, fleet managers and off-grid power users in France and Europe, helping them improve both their financial performance and their environmental footprint.
about.p6: As the exclusive distributor in France, we are committed to providing personalized support and quality service to all our customers.
